column7: Refuses a token request, refresh or code exchange on a clock that reads before 1970, before anything is sent, so no endpoint is called and no token is dated from the epoch (MIK-8202)

Settles through the principal-hashed transition under one bounded rule: one conflict retry, one clock wait (readable_now), the read time reused once taken; a record found terminal on any re-read is never receipted (MIK-8202 P4a)

Settles the original outcome without waiting, dated at the record's own last_updated_at when the clock still reads before 1970 at the wait's end, never 1969 or 0; one re-read on conflict (MIK-8202 P4a)
Re-reads the record owner-scoped and answers None for a terminal record, so a worker whose outcome was not stored never commits a receipt (MIK-8202 P4a r4.1)
Decides whether a settled row holds backend output that a receipt may describe as the peer's (moved from worker.rs)
Routes Settle and Cancel through principal hashing, dating a Settle at a time the caller read and a Cancel on a dark clock at the record's last change, so an owner can always cancel (MIK-8202 P4a)
